hyps.why: Filling an empty direct input-to-output edge restores a path and gains far more than replacing an existing op with a skip.
Adding a conv to an empty edge 3 gives a larger gain than swapping a skip or other op.
With edge 3 missing, edge 5 carries much of the output connectivity, so upgrading it matters more.
With edge 3 missing, edge 4 is a key route to the output, so a conv there helps more.
A skip on edge 4 compensates for the missing direct edge 3 path.
Parents with a skip on edge 0 are low on parametric capacity and gain more from a 3x3 conv.
Skip-dominated parents gain more from adding a conv on edge 2.
Skip-dominated parents gain more from adding a conv on edge 5.
Replacing a removed input edge with a conv gains more than upgrading an existing op.
Without edge 3, an extra skip path via node 2 improves connectivity and helps more.
